# Moinul Islam — QA Automation, Manual & Security Tester

> Moinul Islam is a QA Automation Engineer and manual tester based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with nearly six years of experience (since 2021) testing web, mobile (iOS/Android) and API products. He builds test automation frameworks, uses AI-assisted testing with Claude Code, and is growing into security testing and penetration testing (VAPT). Open to remote roles: QA Automation, SDET, Security QA / VAPT.

## Summary

- Nearly 6 years of manual and automated testing across HRMS & payroll, e-commerce & payment gateways, logistics, supply chain, email-marketing SaaS and digital advertising.
- Built a UI automation framework from scratch (Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, Page Object Model) running in Jenkins CI.
- Reviewed 110+ third-party apps for the Mailchimp Partner Program.
- AI-assisted testing: uses Claude Code for test design, automation scripting and bug reports; built a Hermes Agent assistant bot on Telegram.
- Security: practising web security testing with Burp Suite and the OWASP Top 10, authentication and access-control testing; taking a cyber security course. Certification roadmap: eJPT, then BSCP, then OSCP.

- API & performance testing: Postman, Newman, Rest Assured, JMeter, k6
- Security testing: Burp Suite, OWASP Top 10, VAPT fundamentals, penetration testing fundamentals, authentication testing, access-control testing

## Experience

- Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation), BYSL Global Technology Group — Jan 2023 to present. Set up the QA process, built the Selenium/Java/TestNG framework on Jenkins, automated API regression (Postman/Newman, Rest Assured), led QA for the enterprise HRMS suite on web and Android (Appium), tested e-commerce, logistics and BOM products across web, iPad, iPhone and Android.
- SQA & Test Automation Engineer, Quality Up Services — Apr 2022 to Dec 2022. Reviewed 110+ Mailchimp Partner Program apps, end-to-end testing of Mailchimp mobile web and native iOS/Android apps, Python/Selenium/Pytest automation with Allure reports, API testing.
- SQA Engineer, SEBPO — Jan 2021 to Mar 2022. Cross-browser and cross-device testing of digital ad creatives, test cases from SRS and wireframes, Selenium and Katalon automation, JMeter performance testing.
